inputs: results/coverage/coverage.json (57 of 59 clearing cells carry every defense)

DetectorsComparedModels.meaning: backdoored models in the detector comparison

DetectorsIbdPscFactor.meaning: the amplification factor the IBD-PSC paper fixes

DetectorsAurocDefensesRanked.meaning: defenses the auroc ranking covers, PSBD-TM and the competitors

DetectorsAurocRankOurs.meaning: rank of the recommended placement among every defense by mean auroc

DetectorsAurocRankPublished.meaning: rank the published placement would take among the shown defenses by mean auroc

DetectorsAurocBeatingPublished.meaning: shown defenses with a higher mean auroc than the published placement

DetectorsAurocOurs.meaning: mean auroc of the recommended placement over the compared models

DetectorsAurocPublished.meaning: mean auroc of the published placement over the same models

DetectorsAurocBestCompetitor.meaning: mean auroc of the strongest competitor detector, IBD-PSC$^\ast$

DetectorsAurocBestCompetitorName.meaning: the strongest competitor detector by mean auroc

DetectorsAurocMargin.meaning: mean auroc of the recommended placement minus the strongest competitor

DetectorsAurocSentinet.meaning: mean auroc of the SentiNet port, whose Grad-CAM mask misses the trigger

DetectorsAurocIbdPsc.meaning: mean auroc of IBD-PSC at the paper's fixed amplification factor

DetectorsAurocBelowChanceColumns.meaning: competitor detectors whose mean auroc sits below chance

DetectorsAurocMarginLow.meaning: lower bound of the 95% paired bootstrap interval on detectors_auroc_margin

DetectorsAurocMarginHigh.meaning: upper bound of the 95% paired bootstrap interval on detectors_auroc_margin

DetectorsAurocDatasetsOursLeads.meaning: datasets on which the recommended placement has the highest mean AUROC

DetectorsAurocDatasetsOthersLead.value: Beatrix on CIFAR-10 and TED on GTSRB
DetectorsAurocDatasetsOthersLead.meaning: the defense with the highest mean AUROC on every other dataset
